notes.title: Opening playtest for A Thousand Cloys
notes.notes: [p]Now opening the first playtest for A Thousand Cloys![/p][p][/p][p]The goal for me is to see if players enjoy the game, and how to improve it and its demo. [/p][p][/p][p]Languages available: English, French.[/p][p]Duration: ~4-5 hours[/p][p]Device supported: Keyborad + mouse[/p][p]New players who have requested access will be added to the playtest in waves, so that I can correct and improve everything that has been pointed out by previous players.[/p][p][/p][p]All feedback is very appreciated, either through the form within the game, on my Discord (link available ingame) or here on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45706492/d1463a4f529cd5f1ed8f41a015b0502e8295a89c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks, hope you enjoy the game![/p]
